newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank to inject funds on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank to inject funds on Wednesday.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Wednesday it would inject funds into the banking system later in the day through open-market operations.

The bank typically executes open market operations through bills finance companies, using qualified securities instruments offered by interested financial institutions, but before Tuesday had not done so since late February.
In an unusual twist for Tuesday's and Wednesday's injection, the qualified instruments would be limited to central bank negotiable certificates of deposit.
The central bank said interested financial institutions should contact the bank directly.
Bids would close at 1130 a.m. (0330 GMT), it said.
The funds would be released according to actual demand, the central bank said.
